aboutSection.title: Precision Engineering Since 1999
aboutSection.description: Patel Precision Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified CNC Machining shop in Thane near Mumbai. Proudly serving a wide range of industries, domestic and international with the highest quality of products. Our wide range of capabilities such as our CNC Machining Cell which includes 5 Axis VMC machines, 4 Axis VMC machines, CNC turning Lathes, Bandsaw machines and Cylindrical & Surface Grinding machines. Patel Precision can take care of all your machining needs, from design and development to final product.

about.welcome: Welcome to Patel Precision Pvt. Ltd.

products.heroDesc: Explore our range of high-quality CNC machined products

productsPage.storyP1: Patel Precision Pvt Ltd is an ISO 9001:2015 certified CNC Machining shop in Thane near Mumbai. Proudly serving a wide range of industries, domestic and international with the highest quality of products.
productsPage.storyP2: We do machining on most of the materials like steel and its alloys, Aluminium, Brass, All Stainless Steels (1.4301, 1.4304, 1.4305, 1.4401, 1.4404, 1.4057, 1.4542, Duplex Steel etc), Castings & Forgings, and customer specific material. We are a pioneer in machining high precision components & sub-Assemblies.
productsPage.storyP3: We cater to wide range of industries like Engineering, Automobile, Defence & Aerospace. We strive for excellence in every field and thus consistently work towards achieving total customer satisfaction by upgrading our technology skills to meet the ever rising demands of quality, cost and timely delivery.
productsPage.ctaDesc: Contact us for custom machining solutions tailored to your specific requirements.

infra.heroDesc: World-class manufacturing facility with cutting-edge equipment

infraPage.facilityP1: Patel Precision Pvt. Ltd. has its office and manufacturing facility located in Thane, near Mumbai. The factory has a total operational area of 10,000 sq. ft. with an additional 3,000 sq. ft. expansion space available. The factory works in shifts 24×7.
infraPage.facilityP2: We have all standard instruments for 2D inspection like Trimos, Digital Height Gauges, Digital Micrometers, Digital Verniers, and Dials. We also have a tie-up with NABL certified LAB for Raw Material testing and for 3D inspection we have Mitutoyo CMM, Vision system & Surface tester near our company.
infraPage.facilityP3: All this, coupled with great material handling and storing facility, skilled labour, dedicated team leaders and our experience in the industry make us an ideal choice for all machining requirements.
infraPage.highlight3: Dedicated inspection lab with CMM, profile projector & gauges
infraPage.highlight4: Controlled material storage and batch traceability systems
infraPage.highlight5: Skilled, trained workforce with lean production setup
infraPage.highlight7: Scalable capacity from small batches to high-volume production

certPage.introText: At Patel Precision, quality is the cornerstone of everything we do. Our certifications reflect our unwavering commitment to delivering precision-engineered components that meet the most stringent international standards.
certPage.ctaDesc: Work with a manufacturer that prioritizes quality at every step.
certPage.isoDesc: Our ISO 9001:2015 certification by RAPL (accredited by EGAC & IAF) demonstrates our commitment to maintaining the highest quality standards in manufacture and supply of CNC machined precision components and assemblies. Valid until 09/06/2027.
certPage.nsicDesc: Store Details Certificate issued by The National Small Industries Corporation Limited (A Government of India Enterprise). This certificate covers our full range of CNC machined components, air compressor parts, nozzles, pipe fittings, and more.
certPage.nsicBenefit3: Raw material grade compliance (SS304, SS316L, SS303, etc.)
certPage.railwaysDesc: Registered with Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India for components involving machining. This registration enables us to supply precision components for Indian Railways.

cat0.title: Precision Machined Components
cat0.desc: We manufacture Precision CNC Machined components like Centring Plates, Module parts for weighing scales, Dish washer components, Flanges, Shafts, Adaptors, couplings, Automotive Gear Blanks, Clutch and Brake parts.

cat1.title: CNC Machining Services
cat1.desc: We also undertake precision CNC job work like Automotive Gears & Housings, CNC Turned components, 5 Axis VMC machined components and many critical machined assemblies.

cat2.title: CNC Machined Components
cat2.desc: High-precision CNC machined components manufactured to exacting specifications for diverse industrial applications requiring tight tolerances.

cat3.title: Compressor Valve Assembly
cat3.desc: Complete range of air compressor parts including valve assemblies, pistons, and precision components for all major compressor brands.

cat4.title: 5-Axis Machining Services
cat4.desc: We manufacture many critical components on our 5 Axis VMC machines like Load-cell body for weighing scales, Gear box housings, Aerospace components & Defence Components.

cat5.title: VMC Machining Services
cat5.desc: Vertical Machining Center services with 3, 4 and 5-axis capabilities for complex component manufacturing with precision and efficiency.

cat6.title: CNC Job Work
cat6.desc: We undertake CNC job work for small to large batch production with complete quality assurance and timely delivery.

cat7.title: Compressor Valve Parts
cat7.desc: We manufacture Air compressor valve assemblies for replacement market to the specification of ELGI 100 dia, ELGI 60 dia, Kirloskar Cr105, 90Ds, 100Ds etc.

cat8.title: Pipe Fittings
cat8.desc: Precision manufactured pipe fittings in various materials including stainless steel, brass, and custom alloys for industrial applications.

cat9.title: Rollers
cat9.desc: Industrial rollers manufactured to precise specifications for conveyor systems, printing, textile, and other industrial machinery.

cat10.title: Junction Boxes
cat10.desc: Precision machined junction boxes for electrical and industrial applications with high-quality finish and exact dimensions.

cat11.title: CNC Turned Parts
cat11.desc: High-precision CNC turned parts manufactured on advanced turning centers with live tooling capabilities.

cat12.title: Automotive Components
cat12.desc: Precision automotive components including gear blanks, clutch parts, brake components, and custom automotive machined parts.

cat13.title: Spray Nozzles
cat13.desc: We manufacture all type of Spray nozzles like Jet spray nozzles, Full Cone spray nozzles, and Tank Cleaning spray nozzles as per customers requirements.

cat14.title: Cable Glands
cat14.desc: Industrial cable glands in brass, stainless steel, and other materials for secure cable management in harsh environments.

cat15.title: Machining Services
cat15.desc: Complete machining services from design to finished product, covering turning, milling, drilling, and grinding operations.

cat16.title: Precision Machining
cat16.desc: Ultra-precision machining for critical components requiring tight tolerances and superior surface finish quality.

cat17.title: Fasteners
cat17.desc: Custom and standard fasteners manufactured from various materials with precision threading and surface treatments.

cat18.title: Stainless Steel Flanges
cat18.desc: High-quality stainless steel flanges manufactured to ANSI, DIN, and custom specifications for various industrial applications.

cat19.title: Compressor Valve Plates
cat19.desc: Complete compressor valve assemblies manufactured to OEM specifications for various compressor brands and models.

cat20.title: Medical Components
cat20.desc: We deliver critical precision components for medical devices, including surgical instruments and diagnostic parts. All parts are produced using biocompatible materials under controlled processes that meet international medical manufacturing standards.

cat21.title: Manifold Blocks
cat21.desc: Designed for fluid and air control systems, our manifold blocks offer compact, leak-free integration for complex hydraulic or pneumatic circuits.

cat22.title: Custom Turned Components
cat22.desc: We manufacture precision-turned parts — from intricate micro components to robust, heavy-duty parts — serving industries such as automotive, agriculture, and medical. To deliver complete, production-ready solutions, we also offer value-added services including heat treatments (hardening, tempering, carburizing) and surface treatments like hard chrome plating, anodizing, nitriding, and electropolishing — all through our network of certified suppliers.
